Meeting Title: Customer portal release readiness
Meeting Date: 2026-10-22

Priyanka Rao: Priyanka Rao: Let's anchor the discussion on scope and expected outcome. What has actually changed since the last check-in?
Lucas Martin: Lucas Martin: The current picture is the main user journeys pass, and the final accessibility review is still underway. We have the release checklist has 41 of 45 checks complete and no open severity-one defects, and the signal I am watching is the unresolved checks are keyboard navigation, support handoff, and two browser combinations.
Emma Wilson: Emma Wilson: My concern is launching before the accessibility findings are triaged could block key users. If the accessibility reviewer must return the annotated report, what do we tell the people relying on this work?
Omar Hassan: Omar Hassan: We can hold the release gate until the reviewer classifies each finding and confirms a retest. We should keep whether the remaining keyboard issue is a release blocker or a follow-up visible until that check is complete.
